I have farmed this land since I was young, and I know that sorghum grows better when I mix a little chemical fertilizer with the manure from my animals. My family and I will do all the work ourselves because the plot is small and we cannot spare money to hire help. We will plant the same red sorghum seed we have always saved from last year's harvest, and we will wait for the rains since we have no way to irrigate such a small field.
